optionalAdmission: At most one approximation, selected and frozen using declared validation and cost guards before any scheduled game; never selected by games
backend: research WASM in Node; frozen scalar/SIMD and runtime variant chosen before games
rootSeedMeaning: pinned r84 deterministic legacy root order; no repeated seed slots
schedule: profiles in declared order; ascending frozen opening index; candidate White first for even indices and Black first for odd indices
cpuPolicy: one search at a time, child process pinned to first available CPU, no concurrent cost profiling
failurePolicy: preserve raw incomplete evidence; no resume, replacement, selective retries, optional stopping, or result-based extension

statistics.estimand: candidate points per game averaged equally over the 64 color-reversed opening pairs
statistics.primary: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over opening-pair means
statistics.sensitivity: two-sided 95% cluster-robust Student-t interval grouped by structural family after four recorded plies, preserving endpoint weighting

timeBudgetAudit.unit: identical requested search deadline; report internal WASM-call and full request wall times separately
timeBudgetAudit.failedBudgetAudit: retain all game results but do not describe the campaign as a clean realized equal-time comparison
